visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of several large, white, round steamed buns resting on a metal steamer tray. A hand pulls the tray out of a stainless steel professional steamer. (2) A person's hands pull apart a hot bun to reveal a dense meat filling with two salted egg yolks in the center. The steam is visible rising from the hot food. (3) The camera cuts to a wide shot of the shop interior at night; several customers in casual dark clothing are waiting on a red carpet strip. The lighting is bright fluorescent indoor lighting. (4) A young man wearing a green camouflage tank top and wireless earbuds is shown arranging fresh buns onto a metal cooling rack. The background shows kitchen equipment and wall-mounted fans. (5) A middle-aged woman with short dark hair and a patterned t-shirt stands behind a wooden service counter, talking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (6) A series of close-up shots show various buns being torn open: one with savory meat, one with green-dotted skin and pickled vegetable filling, one with assorted cabbage and glass noodles, and one with a rich red bean paste. (7) A cheese-filled roll bun is pulled apart, showing layers of yellow cheese and bread. Next, a taro-colored mantou with visible chunks is shown being split open. (8) A static shot of a price board displays rows of red and yellow tags listing different bun names and prices in Chinese. (9) The final shot shows the storefront at night with a red sign and a woman carrying a box, overlaid with contact information and location text.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 凌晨三點半. (2) [Subtitle]: 吃剛出爐的包子. (3) [Subtitle]: 這到底是算宵夜還是早餐. (4) [Subtitle]: 高雄這家開了很久的包子店. (5) [Subtitle]: 用老麵發酵. (6) [Subtitle]: 外皮柔軟但很紮實. (7) [Subtitle]: 有十幾種口味可以選. (8) [Subtitle]: 我們自己很喜歡的是蛋黃肉包. (9) [Subtitle]: 肉餡裡面有整顆蛋黃. (10) [Subtitle]: 吃起來很夠味. (11) [Subtitle]: 想吃辣一點的話也有麻辣肉包. (12) [Subtitle]: 酸辣包這顆也不錯. (13) [Subtitle]: 酸菜口感清脆帶一點點辣很順口. (14) [Subtitle]: 不想吃肉的話這裡也有料很豐富的素菜包. (15) [Subtitle]: 甜口味可以試紅豆包. (16) [Subtitle]: 綿密帶顆粒感不會太甜. (17) [Subtitle]: 起司捲有黑糖的甜香. (18) [Subtitle]: 搭配起司多了鹹香感更有層次. (19) [Subtitle]: 饅頭選擇也不少. (20) [Subtitle]: 芋頭饅頭金桔饅頭都有. (21) [Subtitle]: 想挑選多一點口味提早來比較好. (22) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. [Logo]: @hooleefun. (23) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.
